name: mdh-odata-filtered-full-refresh
summary: OData v4 behind an API gateway -> MDH dataset: sweep a server-side-filtered population by numeric $skiptoken, buffer it, and PUT-replace once - so source-side removals propagate and a failed sweep writes nothing.

odata_filter.description: $filter selecting the population, e.g. startswith(Supplier,'<placeholder-prefix>'); empty = the whole entity set (then this IS the nightly drift companion for a watermark sync)

expand_nav.description: one navigation property to flatten onto the row as <nav>_<field> columns; empty for none

select_fields.description: comma-separated $select; empty = all fields. Keep any field you filter or key on

order_by.description: $orderby - the entity key, for stable offset paging

runtime_budget_s.description: wall-clock budget; the sweep aborts WITHOUT writing when exceeded

provenance: Lifted from a production one-time-vendor address feed (2026-08): a startswith() filter on the placeholder vendor prefix selected 5,134 of ~2.33M purchase orders (0.2%), swept in ~20s over 12 pages of 500, with the header's _SupplierAddress expanded and flattened. 259 of those rows carried no LastChangeDateTime, which is why a watermark sync was rejected for this feed. Generalized here and not yet run in this form - hence candidate.
notes: Never PUT an empty result - the fragment refuses, because a source hiccup would otherwise wipe a working dataset. A standalone `or` in the $filter is rejected by the gateway (403 FORBIDDEN_PARAMETER); express the population with `and`, startswith(), or ranges. ~5k rows is a few MB, well inside the 256MB runtime; a population that no longer fits one run belongs in mdh-odata-import-skiptoken-sync.
